project_type: React SPA with Konva canvas - architectural panel configuration tool
verification_instructions: 1. Run typecheck: cd frontend && npm run typecheck. 2. Run build: cd frontend && npm run build. 3. Run tests: cd frontend && NODE_OPTIONS="" npx vitest run. 4. Ensure all existing test data-testid selectors still work.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode. No Docker. Use host-based validation only.
contribution_requirements: Do not change business rules, calculation logic, database schema, APIs, validation rules, or canvas geometry behavior. UI/UX layer only.
key_patterns: 1. Inline styles using design system CSS custom properties (--color-*, --space-*, --text-*, etc.). 2. Zustand stores for state management. 3. data-testid attributes on all interactive elements. 4. CSS utility classes in components.css (btn-primary, btn-secondary, input, panel, etc.). 5. All panels use width 280-320px with borderLeft 1px solid --color-hairline. 6. Typography from typography.css (Inter font, --text-xs through --text-2xl). 7. Components reference colors by hex with comment noting the CSS variable name.
directory_structure: frontend/src/components/ - UI panels and controls. frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand state stores. frontend/src/canvas/ - Konva canvas layers, interactions, utils. frontend/src/engines/ - Business logic engines (wall config, panel frame generation). frontend/src/styles/ - CSS design system files. frontend/src/types/ - TypeScript type definitions.
